description: Java class implementing NFC foreground dispatch API example for handling NFC tags and intents.

classes.name: ForegroundDispatch
classes.description: An example activity demonstrating NFC foreground dispatch API usage.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up NFC intent filters and tech lists.

methods.description: Enables NFC foreground dispatch when activity resumes.
